A long article that scrolls for about eight viewports

Each numbered marker below must appear exactly once, in order, in the stitched capture. A duplicated or missing marker means a tiling bug.

MARKER 01 — top

Opening

The sticky header above should be captured a single time, at the very top of the resulting image. If it repeats every viewport, the fixed-element policy is not being applied after the first frame.

Smooth scrolling is enabled on this document on purpose. The capture engine must force scroll-behavior: auto, otherwise frames are taken mid-animation and the stitch tears.
